supporting_observations.claim: At 13:45 UTC, a proxy request attributed to ORCHARD\amy.cole successfully retrieved https://raw.githubusercontent.com/orchard-it/tools/main/u.ps1 with status 200. The proxy records show a CONNECT tunnel and an inspected GET; they do not show whether the downloaded script was executed.

Around 13:40 UTC, the recorded Kerberos requests from WS-ACOLE-01 were for the workstation computer account and services on DC-ORC-01 or FILE-ORC-01. These records do not identify a PowerShell process or establish that the requests were caused by the reported window.
The script retrieval shortly after the reported time is relevant to investigate, but the available records do not establish that it was related to the reported PowerShell window.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied sensor-coverage status reports that WS-ACOLE-01 winsec and Sysmon collection was unavailable from 13:25 through 14:15 UTC, covering the reported event time.
The available network and authentication records do not provide the missing endpoint process-creation, PowerShell, or script-execution evidence.
claims_not_established: Whether PowerShell actually ran on WS-ACOLE-01 around 13:40 UTC, and what command line, parent process, user context, or content it used.
Whether the u.ps1 download at 13:45 UTC was executed, authorized, or connected to the reported window.
Whether the download's repository, script content, and purpose were legitimate.
Whether any changes or other actions resulted from the reported activity.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover or obtain endpoint EDR, PowerShell operational, process-creation, and command-line telemetry for WS-ACOLE-01 covering the event and surrounding period.
Retrieve the proxy-cached response or otherwise obtain the exact contents and hash of u.ps1; verify the repository's ownership, commit history, and authorization.
Check endpoint browser/download artifacts and execution traces to determine whether the downloaded script was opened or run.
Compare the activity with change records or administrator activity to determine whether this script retrieval was expected.
unrelated_findings: At 13:45 UTC, FILE-ORC-01 made connection attempts toward WS-ACOLE-01 on ports 135, 22, and 8443; the observed attempts were rejected or had no completed connection. The available records do not link these attempts to the reported PowerShell activity; track separately if needed. (T263-00155, T263-00156, T263-00159, T263-00160, T263-00161)
